AZRAR SPATIAL DESIGN / FIRST-TIME SETUP

Draw your studio walls.

First draw a CLOSED OUTER OUTLINE to define the real floor. Add interior partitions, windows, glass, and doors afterward. Applying reorganizes your offices and furniture INSIDE the new footprint.

Click to set the first point. Every following click creates a straight wall.
Grid snapping: 0.5 mOrthogonal drawing: ON0 WALLS
DESIGN MODE

Draw continuous walls

Click a starting point, then click additional points to form room boundaries. Segments snap horizontally or vertically. Select “Finish chain” to start a new room.

SELECTED SEGMENT
Select a wall to set Solid, Window, Glass or Door, move its endpoints, or delete it.
HOW IT WORKS

1. Draw the OUTER boundary with 3+ corners.
2. Click Close outline to connect back to the start.
3. Add interior walls and set their types: Window, Door, or Glass.
4. Apply: the parquet floor and furniture fit inside your plan.
5. Switch to Light mode for daylight through openings.

Your layout is saved on this device and can be exported with the studio data.

Closed footprint = real floor, walls, offices and meeting furniture
